Package io.webagent4j.policy

package io.webagent4j.policy
Generic, synchronous execution-policy contracts shared across WebAgent4J modules.

This package defines the vocabulary every governed-execution gate is built from: IExecutionPolicy, a pure function from an immutable context to a PolicyDecision. There are exactly two possible outcomes (PolicyOutcome.ALLOW or PolicyOutcome.DENY) - no UNKNOWN, ASK, or deferred outcome exists, so a caller can never be left uncertain about whether a side effect may proceed.

Nothing in this package performs I/O, blocks, retries, or calls out to a remote service (HTTP, MCP, an LLM, a database). Evaluation is synchronous, in-process, and deterministic given its input - callers that need those things build them into their own IExecutionPolicy implementation, which this package treats as ordinary, untrusted, unsandboxed Java code.

Action-specific and network-specific policy contracts live in io.webagent4j.action (action authorization, webagent4j-action) and io.webagent4j.policy.network (network-destination governance, this module) respectively, both built on the generic contracts defined here.
